title: Subagent frontmatter (subagent-v1)
$comment: Source: ADR-109. A subagent is an addressable, tool-scoped execution context projected to a host's native subagent format (Claude Code `.claude/agents/`) or, on non-subagent hosts, to a loadable context file. Static projection only — dispatch stays with the host/user, never runtime-enforced. Governance fields (trust, lifecycle, discovery.visible) are REQUIRED, mirroring the skill trust block so subagents share one governance model. model_tier reuses model_tier.ts (ADR-034/035).

name.description: Addressable handle. Must match the subagent filename stem and be globally unique within the subagent category (projection-path collision guard).

description.description: User-facing summary. On Claude Code this drives `@`-menu discoverability; keep it action-oriented.

model_tier.description: Vendor-neutral capability band (ADR-034/035). high/medium/lite project to a native Claude `model:` (high→opus, medium→sonnet, lite→haiku) via model_tier.ts; `inherit` is a documented passthrough sentinel (→ CC `model: inherit`), not a new mapping.

effort.description: Optional pinned reasoning-effort level. Projects into the generated .claude/agents/<name>.md frontmatter (`effort:`) on hosts with an effort knob; ignored elsewhere. Orthogonal to `model_tier`. Omit for host-default effort.

tools.description: A tool grant: one of the Claude Code tool names, optionally scoped — `Bash(npm test:*)` grants one command family where a bare `Bash` grants a shell. The base name stays closed, so a typo still fails CI rather than producing broken `.claude/agents/` YAML in the user's IDE; only the optional `(...)` suffix is new. Prefer the narrowest grant the task actually needs, per tool-safety Least Agency.
tools.$comment: Was a bare enum, which made the scoped-grant syntax `tool-safety` prescribes literally inexpressible here — a schema forbidding what the rule asks for. skill.schema.json's allowed_tools permits that syntax by validating nothing at all; this pattern permits it while keeping the base-name guarantee that made the enum worth having.

trust.description: ADR-013 trust block, mirrored from the skill schema so subagents share one governance model.

visible.description: Subagents are default-off. The value MUST be false; a pack/profile opts in explicitly via include: ["subagent:<name>"].

requires_capability.description: Host-capability gate (e.g. claude_subagents). Hosts without the capability receive the loadable-context-file degradation, not native dispatch.
